# the --save-turret --capture-tag spawn-15 gunner (allies).
#
# Three shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32562 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <1.5 install> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32562 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <1.5 install> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32562 --save-turret --capture-tag spawn-15 --probe-secs 190
# The axis client started 10 s after the server and the gunner 5 s after it.

# made on the first script frame the player reads "playing", at getTime().
